dish: lemongrass pork bánh mì, shoyu ramen and okonomiyaki
w: Longtime Over-the-Rhine Asian street-food gastropub (the name means 'mixed' in Vietnamese) — Korean fried-chicken wings, house okonomiyaki, shoyu ramen and lemongrass pork bánh mì. Reopened and confirmed open 2025.

dish: tandoori boti kebab and bhartha mushroom
w: Clifton's standout Indian kitchen (now Indian & Nepali) across from Cincinnati State — CityBeat and Cincinnati Magazine both call it arguably the city's best Indian, praising the charcoal-fired tandoori boti kebab and smoky bhartha. Open 2026.

The Wong family's upscale Cantonese-American institution, open in Ft. Mitchell since 1977 (with a Hyde Park sibling) — a near-50-year Greater Cincinnati staple profiled by Cincinnati Magazine and WCPO. Order the honey chicken or Peking duck.

A family-run West Side hole-in-the-wall many locals (and pro chefs) call the best gyro in Cincinnati, with Greek salad, spanakopita and Greek fries alongside. WCPO's 'holy grail' gyro pick and a CityBeat reader Best Mediterranean.

OTR's apothecary-themed cocktail bar (open since 2015), turning out freshly-mixed classics and drafts like the King's Remedy in a turn-of-the-century pharmacy setting — a repeatedly award-listed Cincinnati bar. Confirmed open under new ownership.

dish: craft classic cocktails in the historic 1879 room
w: Main Street OTR's 'cocktail cathedral,' built in an 1879 wig-and-hair shop and made famous by mixologist Molly Wellmann — deep menu of house and classic cocktails. Confirmed open.

dish: Tarantino-themed cocktails behind a hidden VHS door
w: A Walnut Hills video-rental storefront hiding a Quentin Tarantino-themed speakeasy behind a rigged VHS tape — grindhouse decor, films projected behind the bar and cocktails like Shoshanna's Revenge. Now runs as the reservation-only Tiki-Tiki Bang Bang show; open 2025.
OTR artisan boulangerie whose traditional French sourdough and baguettes earned Food & Wine's 'best bread in Ohio' nod (via CityBeat); pastries and sandwiches too. Open, with a Madisonville sibling.

dish: single-origin pour-overs and nitro cold brew
w: Cincinnati specialty roaster (since 2011) whose Oakley coffee bar pours single-origin drip and a much-praised nitro cold brew; roasts in the West End with cafes in Oakley, OTR and downtown. A CityBeat 'better than Starbucks' pick.

Northside brewery in the historic St. Patrick's Church that owns Cincinnati's 'Midwest Fruit Tart' sour niche — wild and fruited sours like The Gadget gose — plus a taproom, bar and live-music venue. Cincinnati Magazine covered its milestone anniversary.

dish: house IPA and scratch gastropub plates
w: Pleasant Ridge brewpub pairing expertly-made house beer with scratch gastropub cooking (burgers, shareable small plates) — a neighborhood favorite reviewed by CityBeat and WCPO. Barrel-aged offerings at its nearby Fermentorium.

dish: house IPAs with live music and BBQ
w: Music-themed Blue Ash microbrewery with a dozen-plus taps, weekly live music and in-house BBQ — a fixture on Cincinnati Magazine's craft-brewery bucket list.

dish: rotating IPAs with Street Chef Brigade eats
w: Envelope-pushing brewery in Columbia-Tusculum, Cincinnati's oldest neighborhood, with a dog-friendly patio and the Street Chef Brigade food truck parked out front daily. On Cincinnati Magazine's brewery bucket list.

dish: old-world-style lagers and a scratch kitchen
w: Silverton's first brewery, in the former municipal building — old-world lagers with a modern twist, a top-notch full kitchen, and a sustainability bent (100% wind-powered, a carbon-neutral beer). CityBeat feature; Cincinnati Magazine bucket list.

OTR Brewery District brewery-and-distillery in Christian Moerlein's 1895 icehouse — clean lagers and ales (pilsner, amber marzen) plus house-distilled gin, whiskey and bourbon, with a scratch kitchen. CityBeat feature; Cincinnati Magazine bucket list.

Mason's largest brewery-taproom and beer garden (32 taps), built on traditional German styles plus innovative hazy IPAs. Featured by Cincinnati Refined and on Cincinnati Magazine's brewery bucket list.
